en.title: Mélenchon's La France Insoumise Publishes 2027 Presidential Platform
en.dek: The party's platform makes environmental transformation its top priority and reaffirms retirement at age 60.
facts: La France Insoumise published its presidential platform on 6 November.
Le Monde reported the platform makes environmental transformation its top priority.
The program reaffirms retirement at age 60, according to Le Monde.
Politico Europe reported the plan would require confrontation with European institutions.
Le Monde reported Mélenchon builds the platform around the idea of a 'new France'.
body: La France Insoumise published its presidential platform on 6 November, according to Politico Europe and Le Monde. The document sets out the party's program for the 2027 French presidential election, and both outlets reported on its contents the same day.

Le Monde reported that the platform makes environmental transformation its top priority. The same report said the program reaffirms retirement at age 60, and it placed those measures at the center of the party's election program.

Politico Europe reported that the plan would require a confrontation with European institutions. The outlet said Mélenchon squares up to Brussels in the election manifesto, and it described the platform as previewing an EU confrontation.

Le Monde reported that Mélenchon builds the campaign platform around the idea of a 'new France.' The report described the party as radical left, and it said the platform was published for the 2027 election.

The platform links environmental transformation and retirement at age 60 with a confrontation with European institutions, according to the two reports. Politico Europe reported on the conflict with European institutions, and Le Monde reported on the environmental and retirement measures.

Both Politico Europe and Le Monde published their reports on 6 November. The platform is the party's stated program for the 2027 presidential election, and it addresses the environment, retirement, and European institutions.
en.context: Jean-Luc Mélenchon leads La France Insoumise. The party published its presidential platform on 6 November for the 2027 French presidential election. Le Monde described the party as radical left.

en.headline: Mélenchon's party publishes presidential platform for 2027 election
en.body: Jean-Luc Mélenchon's La France Insoumise published its presidential platform on 6 November, according to Politico Europe and Le Monde. Le Monde reported the program makes environmental transformation its top priority and reaffirms retirement at age 60. Politico Europe reported the plan would require a confrontation with European institutions.

it.headline: Il partito di Mélenchon pubblica il programma presidenziale per le elezioni del 2027
it.body: Secondo Politico Europe e Le Monde, La France Insoumise di Jean-Luc Mélenchon ha pubblicato il suo programma presidenziale il 6 novembre. Le Monde ha riferito che il programma pone la trasformazione ambientale al primo posto e riafferma il pensionamento a 60 anni. Politico Europe ha riferito che il piano richiederebbe un confronto con le istituzioni europee.

fr.headline: Le parti de Mélenchon publie son programme présidentiel pour l’élection de 2027
fr.body: Selon Politico Europe et Le Monde, La France insoumise de Jean-Luc Mélenchon a publié son programme présidentiel le 6 novembre. Le Monde a indiqué que le programme fait de la transition écologique sa priorité absolue et réaffirme la retraite à 60 ans. Politico Europe a rapporté que le plan nécessiterait une confrontation avec les institutions européennes.

es.headline: El partido de Mélenchon publica su plataforma presidencial para las elecciones de 2027
es.body: El partido de Jean-Luc Mélenchon, La France Insoumise, publicó su plataforma presidencial el 6 de noviembre, según Politico Europe y Le Monde. Le Monde informó de que el programa sitúa la transformación ambiental como su máxima prioridad y reafirma la jubilación a los 60 años. Politico Europe informó de que el plan exigiría un enfrentamiento con las instituciones europeas.

de.headline: Mélenchons Partei veröffentlicht Präsidentschaftsprogramm für die Wahl 2027
de.body: Jean-Luc Mélenchons La France Insoumise hat nach Angaben von Politico Europe und Le Monde am 6. November ihr Präsidentschaftsprogramm veröffentlicht. Le Monde berichtete, dass das Programm die ökologische Transformation zur obersten Priorität macht und den Renteneintritt mit 60 Jahren bekräftigt. Politico Europe berichtete, der Plan würde eine Konfrontation mit den europäischen Institutionen erfordern.

pt.headline: O partido de Mélenchon publica programa presidencial para as eleições de 2027
pt.body: A La France Insoumise, de Jean-Luc Mélenchon, publicou o seu programa presidencial a 6 de novembro, segundo a Politico Europe e o Le Monde. O Le Monde informou que o programa torna a transformação ambiental a sua principal prioridade e reafirma a reforma aos 60 anos. A Politico Europe informou que o plano exigiria um confronto com as instituições europeias.

ja.headline: メランション氏の党、2027年大統領選公約を発表
ja.body: ジャン＝リュック・メランション氏率いる「不屈のフランス」（LFI）は11月6日、2027年大統領選の公約を発表した。ポリティコ・ヨーロッパとル・モンドが報じた。ル・モンドによると、この綱領は環境転換を最優先課題とし、60歳での退職を改めて確認する内容だという。ポリティコ・ヨーロッパは、この計画は欧州の諸機関との対決を必要とするものだと報じた。

ko.headline: 멜랑숑 정당, 2027년 대선 공약 발표
ko.body: 장뤼크 멜랑숑의 정당 굴복하지 않는 프랑스가 11월 6일 대선 공약을 발표했다고 폴리티코 유럽과 르몽드가 전했다. 르몽드는 이 프로그램이 환경 전환을 최우선 과제로 삼고 60세 퇴직을 재확인한다고 보도했다. 폴리티코 유럽은 이 안이 유럽 기구와의 대립을 필요로 할 것이라고 전했다.

zh.headline: 梅朗雄所属政党发布2027年总统竞选纲领
zh.body: 据Politico Europe和《世界报》报道，让-吕克·梅朗雄所属的不屈法国于11月6日发布了总统竞选纲领。《世界报》报道称，该纲领将环境转型列为首要任务，并重申60岁退休。Politico Europe报道称，该计划需要与欧洲机构对抗。
